summary: Tested the major pivot: itinerary recommendation engine + sponsor weighting + admin updates. Created /app/backend/tests/test_itinerary.py with 16 tests covering /api/itinerary/generate shape, slot order, variety, exclude_ids, persistence, business_appearance analytics, sponsor weighting (60-run statistical test), admin sponsor_tier validation, featured auto-sync, slots persistence, and analytics summary additions. All 16 new tests PASS. Full regression: 66/67 pass (1 transient connect timeout on /api/health). Frontend smoke: /tonight renders TONIGHT'S MOVE header, all 4 step cards (dinner/drinks/entertainment/late-night), GIVE ME ANOTHER NIGHT button, SPONSORED badges, Call/Directions/Website buttons, and itinerary changes on regenerate. VibePage -> /tonight?vibe=very-down navigation works. Admin: 30 sponsor badges in table, sponsor-tier select + 4 slot checkboxes in form, sponsor performance table + Itinerary views/Another Night clicks/Business appearances metric cards all present.

minor.issue: Single transient ConnectTimeout in a 2-minute regression run (1/67 tests). Re-runs pass. Not reproducible.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is approaching 800 lines; consider splitting itinerary logic, admin routes, and analytics into separate modules for maintainability.
Backfill migration runs on every startup which is fine (idempotent) but could be moved to a one-shot script with a version flag for production.
Sponsor weighting test passed (platinum >> none) but exact ratio not asserted; statistical bound is loose by design to avoid flake.
